# Jeremiah 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Thus said YHWH: "Go and-buy a-potter's earthen-flask, and-[take some] of-the-elders-of the-people and-of-the-elders-of the-priests,

**2** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**3** And-say, 'Hear [the]-word-of YHWH, kings-of Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem! Thus says YHWH-of hosts, God-of Israel: Behold-Me bringing evil upon this place, which everyone hearing-it — his-ears will-tingle.'

**4** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**5** And-they-built the-high-places-of Baal to-burn their-sons in-the-fire [as]-burnt-offerings to-Baal, which I-did-not-command and-did-not-speak, and-[it]-did-not-come-up upon-My-heart.

**6** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**7** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**8** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**9** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**10** "Then-you-shall-break the-flask before-the-eyes-of the-men who-go with-you,

**11** And-you-shall-say to-them, 'Thus says YHWH-of hosts: So I-will-break this people and-this city, as-one-breaks a-potter's vessel which cannot be-repaired again.'"

**12** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**13** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**14** And-YHWH declared judgment upon-Jerusalem at-the-Valley-of Ben-Hinnom for-their-abominations.

**15** "Thus says YHWH-of hosts, God-of Israel: Behold-Me bringing upon this city and-upon all her-towns all the-evil which I-spoke against-her, because they-stiffened their-neck to-not hear My-words."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **19:1**: Opening formula for the the shattered flask oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **19:7**: Central imagery of broken vessel — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **19:15**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
